🎥🔪: Weapons (2025)

When an entire classroom of children mysteriously disappears during the same night, a quiet community is thrown into panic. With no signs of forced entry and almost no clues, suspicion spreads among parents, neighbors, and local authorities as everyone searches for answers.

As the investigation deepens, hidden secrets begin to surface, revealing that the disappearances may be connected to something far more disturbing than anyone imagined. The lives of a teacher, grieving families, and other townspeople become increasingly intertwined as fear and paranoia consume the community.

Blending psychological horror with mystery, Weapons gradually uncovers the truth behind the shocking event, building tension through unsettling twists and an atmosphere of growing dread.

source_details.synopsis: Weapons is a 2025 American supernatural mystery horror film directed, written, produced, and co-scored by Zach Cregger. It stars an ensemble cast including Josh Brolin, Julia Garner, Alden Ehrenreich, Austin Abrams, Cary Christopher, Toby Huss, Benedict Wong, and Amy Madigan. Its plot follows the case of seventeen children from the same classroom who mysteriously run away on the same night at the same time. After the critical and commercial success of his film Barbarian (2022), Cregger began working on the spec script for Weapons.
